draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.80, the 181st-best grade among 253 2019 draftees and 25th of 32 at CB. He lasted until pick 227, well after his grade rank (181st): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Tony Carter. Testing concerns: broad jump (16th percentile).

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2021. 37 career games and 10 starts over 3 completed seasons. Career-best season: 3 AV in 2020. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (2nd percentile). Played 7 of 17 games in 2021.
